description: Adult sexual arousal: physiological sexual activation, desire, attraction, erotic anticipation, and erotic imagery. All interpersonal examples must involve adults.

target_facets.A1: physiological sexual arousal or bodily sexual activation in an adult
target_facets.A2: anticipatory sexual desire or wanting physical intimacy with another adult
target_facets.A3: attentional capture by an adult one finds sexually attractive
target_facets.A4: reciprocal interpersonal sexual tension, flirtation, or attraction between adults
target_facets.A5: erotic imagination, fantasy, or urge involving consenting adults

controls.B: fear or threat-related physiological activation without sexual desire
controls.C1: high positive nonsexual excitement, anticipation, or thrill
controls.C2: romantic affection, tenderness, or closeness without sexual charge
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
controls.E: nonsexual bodily sensation or physiological activation

absent_control: Adult romantic, attractive, intimate, or body-related situations where sexual arousal is explicitly absent because there is no attraction, the interaction is clinical/platonic, the person is satiated or uninterested, or another clear blocker applies.
